en-US.author: Yoan98
en-US.description: An AI assistant for working with the office documents on your computer.
en-US.longDescription:
NCurator is a local-first AI assistant built around the office documents on your own computer.
- Office document work: read, create and edit DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and plain-text files, and read PDFs.
- Local knowledge base: index large numbers of files, retrieve content, and cite the sources.
- Web search: search the web, read pages, and drive the built-in browser.
- Local terminal: run local commands and scripts for data processing and task automation.
- Change review: inspect revision history, review diffs, and roll back supported file changes.
- WPS integration: click a change to open the document in WPS at that position, and refresh the document after AI edits or rollbacks.
- Scheduled tasks: run tasks on a schedule and reuse a partner's models and configuration.
en-US.name: NCurator

zh-CN.description: 处理本地办公文件的 AI 助手。
zh-CN.longDescription:
馆长是一款本地优先的 AI 助手，围绕你电脑上的办公文件展开工作。
- 办公文件处理：读取、创建和编辑 DOCX、PPTX、XLSX 与纯文本文件，支持 PDF 阅读。
- 本地知识库：支持大量文件索引处理，检索内容并引用来源。
- 网页搜索：搜索网络信息、读取网页内容，并可操作内置浏览器。
- 本地终端：执行本地命令和脚本，完成数据处理与任务自动化。
- 改动审核：查看修改记录，审核改动差异，回退支持的文件改动。
- WPS 联动：点击 AI 改动处，在 WPS 中打开文档并定位；AI 修改或回退后自动刷新文档。
- 定时任务：按计划执行任务，复用伙伴的资料与模型配置。
